quickAnswer.question: What international tour packages does iWay Tourism offer from Trivandrum?
quickAnswer.answer: iWay Tourism offers all-inclusive international packages from Trivandrum Airport (TRV) covering Singapore & Malaysia, Bali (Indonesia), Vietnam, Sri Lanka, Dubai (UAE), and Thailand — plus emerging destinations like Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan, and Nepal. Every package includes return flights, visa processing, hotel accommodation, airport transfers, sightseeing, and a dedicated trip coordinator. Prices start from ₹20,000 per person for Sri Lanka to ₹1,30,000+ for premium Singapore-Malaysia cruises.

overview: Every international package from iWay Tourism is built on a simple principle: you should not need to coordinate with multiple vendors. We handle the flight booking from Trivandrum Airport (TRV), the visa paperwork, the hotel reservations, the airport transfers at the destination, the sightseeing itinerary, and the travel insurance recommendation — as a single, all-inclusive package with one coordinator, one quote, and one point of contact throughout your trip. We do not resell white-label packages from aggregator portals. Every itinerary is designed by consultants who have personally visited the destinations, and every price quoted includes what it says — no hidden charges, no surprise surcharges at checkout.

faqs.question: Do your international packages include flights from Trivandrum?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every iWay Tourism international package includes return flights from Trivandrum International Airport (TRV). We coordinate flight bookings to align with the itinerary, optimizing for the best combination of price and travel time. For destinations not served by direct flights from TRV, we arrange the most efficient connection — typically via Colombo, Kuala Lumpur, or Singapore.

faqs.question: Do you handle visa processing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Visa processing is included in every international package. For e-visa destinations (Vietnam, Sri Lanka when applicable, Dubai), we handle the online application, document preparation, and submission. For embassy-submitted visas (Singapore, Malaysia), we prepare your complete application file and coordinate the submission. Sri Lanka currently offers visa-free entry for Indian passport holders, so no visa processing is needed for that destination.
